layout.title: Volcano

shows.does: deep under the mountain the chamber glows and orange magma rises through the ground
gas bubbles swell in the glowing chamber and yellow arrows push up
a blast bursts out of the top of the mountain and smoke climbs
grey ash pours out of the open vent and drifts over the whole land
the ash falls and piles up as a grey layer on the cone's slopes
the loose grey ash slides down the slope in a cloud of dust
glowing lava pours over the slope, then darkens as it cools into rock
a glowing lava stream runs down the slope into the river, steam bursts up and the boat drifts away
the water chills the lava stream and a black layer of rock forms on the slope
a black plug of cold rock fills the top of the vent and the glow below dies
a new blast clears the plug from the vent and a new layer forms on the cone
a glowing line traces the layered cone
the magma cools and white snow caps the peak, the boat bobbing on the river
the finished snowy volcano stands calm in section by the river with its boat

layout.why: A mountain cut through its middle (terrain with a cone, its magma chamber glowing in the face) beside a river where a toy boat floats. The story follows the magma up and out: gas pressure, a blast opens the vent, ash flies and piles into a cone, the loose ash slides, lava pours over and cools, the lava reaches the river and is chilled to rock, the rock plugs the vent, the next blast clears it and adds a layer. The camera opens close on the rising magma, then holds the whole section with the river.

sentences.text: If you let magma rise through the ground, you have a volcano.
But gas in the magma swells, and pressure builds.
So the gas blasts open a vent.
But the vent throws ash into the sky.
So the ash falls and piles into a cone.
But the loose ash slides down the slopes.
So lava pours over it and cools into rock.
But the lava flows on into the river.
So the water chills it into black rock.
But the cold rock plugs the vent again.
So the next blast clears it and adds a layer.
Let the magma cool, and snow caps the peak.
Congratulations, you have built a volcano.

recurring.what: a toy boat on the river at the foot of the volcano

chain.shows: gas bubbles swell in the magma chamber and push up
chain.stakes: the mountain is about to burst

chain.shows: the open vent throws ash high over the land
chain.stakes: the land around is buried in ash

chain.shows: the loose ash cone slides down its slopes
the lava flows on down the slope into the river and steam bursts up
the cold black rock plugs the vent and the gas is trapped again
chain.stakes: a bigger blast threatens the whole valley

ideas.idea: magma rising through the ground is already a volcano
gas in the magma swells and the pressure builds
the gas blasts a vent open through the top
the open vent throws ash into the sky
the ash falls back and piles up into a cone
loose ash cannot hold a slope and slides down
lava pours over the ash and cools into hard rock
the lava keeps flowing and reaches the river
the river water chills the lava into black rock
the cold rock plugs the vent and the gas is trapped again
the next blast clears the plug and adds another layer
layer on layer of ash and lava: a stratovolcano
the magma cools and snow caps the peak
